release_notes: COLONY now opens as a blank one-color command surface with one outlined search/command bar.
Apps and information are summoned into one standardized tab/window model with minimize, maximize, close, list, grid, graph, document and runtime views.
Added a visible App Builder: choose a source and display mode, watch the preview assemble, then save the app for instant recall by name.
MOOR City opens as an embedded runtime surface; Continuity, Renderer, ChatGPT and Updates remain summonable by typing their names.
Wallpaper and saved app state persist locally; private COLONY project data is not published in this update.
